main_text.p: Probatur, nam corrupta rosa, vel ea entitas manet adhuc, vel non si primum, ergo rosa non corrumpitur, sed perseuerat: si secundum, ergo rosa non amplius est: sed illa erat substantia; ergo substantia cessat esse in natura, & omnino perit. Respond. d. antecedens. Cessat esse in natura entitas mixta, c. simplex, nego. Dico igitur, quòd rosa dum corrumpitur, non perseuerat quidem, sed tamen substantiae partes, quae seorsim acceptae rosa non sunt, illae manent. Quemadmodum, ergo si resoluatur domus, tollitur sanè aliquod compositum, sed non materiae primae, lapides, caementa, trabes, &c. ita de quouis mixto dicendum, non corrumpi substantias actu, sed resolui, & haec vera mixtorum corruptio est, vt dis-put. sequen-ti.

page.notes: The printed text is set in a shape that narrows line by line, so line breaks were not kept. The symbol (*_*) is partly unclear and may read differently. Some small marks at the line ends are not clear. Printing errors were left as they are. The catchword DIS- stands at the foot right.
